caption_source.words: "How long do you think it'll take to scan this car?" / "I'll say two hours."
"How long do you think it'll take to scan this car?" / "Maybe 30 minutes."
"How long do you think it'll take to scan this car?" / "I think I can do it in less than the length of a YouTube video. 15 minutes."
"Huh?" "Yeah." "Three, two, one, go."
"I'm so confident in my ability, I'm not gonna rush. I gotta take my time." / "Oh no, oh no, that's not the right one."
"Then when I'm done spraying the car, show the watch. Okay, I'm gonna show the watch periodically." / "Yeah, checkpoint."
"Checkpoint. Just two minutes."
"The corner of the left headlight. You see how it's like not fully covered?" / "Got you."
"Time check." / "What? Oh, it's switched. Five minutes on the dot." / "How you feeling halfway through it?" / "It just crashed. It's never crashed on me before."
"We're still rolling."
"Yeah, once this is sorted out, I'm just gonna start a new scan." / "Yeah, I know."
"So, what happened? So the scanner crashed. So after like a five minute delay, we're rebooting it. And now we're gonna try again. All right, let's start the... start a secondary timer. Now." / "Yup."
"So, are you still recording?" "Yep." "So that's the exterior. That's done. Check mark. What's the time?" "The cheating time is 8 minutes and 32 seconds."

"This is the full walk around of the car. Front, hood, roof, right side. Rear quarter panel's a little messed up. Roof's messed up. So I came back here, did the whole roof, did the right quarter panel, fixed the trunk." / "That's the full interior. So now, if you wanna make a lip kit, let's jack the car up, do the fronts and sides, wheel wells inside. So let's also time that."
"For harder-to-reach areas, I'll use the can."
"It's a crazy position." "Is this the most optimal scanning position?" "Yeah."
"Oh, under the car! It disappeared!"
"Oh, it's right here. Right?" "Oh yeah, it is. It blended in." "I do the same thing all the time."
"Okay." "Done?" "Nope." "Oh yeah, almost done."
"Time. 20 minutes. Done. And the other one, 32 minutes. Yep."
"If we ignore the scanner crashing on me... 20 minutes. 20 minutes for the whole car, 10 minutes if I just did the exterior, with the power of a spray gun, AESUB Violet, and the Artec Leo."
